people.name: Richard Alan Siegel
people.partner_quote: Managing Partner / Wealth Advisor Director of Finance & Investments
people.bio_note: Co-founder and Managing Partner of ARQ Wealth Advisors, CFP since 2001, in the industry since 1996. Before co-founding ARQ, he was a Senior Financial Planner at The Vanguard Group, developing investment, retirement, and estate strategies for affluent investors, including Fortune 500 executives and dot-com-era millionaires. Graduate of SUNY Albany (psychology and business administration, 1991). Originally from New York; moved to Scottsdale in 1995.
people.bio_source: arqwealth.com/rich-siegel (firm's own website states his prior role as Senior Financial Planner at The Vanguard Group and his SUNY Albany 1991 degree). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): his LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/rich-siegel-cfp-87720549) could not be directly re-accessed (blocked), but indirect search of the same URL's indexed content is consistent with these facts -- treating as corroborated, with the firm's own site as the primary standing source per current policy.

people.name: James Nelson Robinson
people.bio_note: Co-founder and Partner at ARQ Wealth Advisors, Director of Business Development. Goes by 'Jay.' Entered financial services in 2004; before becoming an advisor, was the #1-ranked wholesaler for a $3B+ independent broker-dealer. Holds RICP and AIF designations. Attended University of Mississippi and graduated with honors from University of Texas at El Paso (psychology and business management). Has appeared as a financial contributor on ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, and CNN, and teaches retirement/estate planning and Social Security classes at local colleges. Originally from Harrisonburg, VA; relocated to Scottsdale in 2006.
people.bio_source: arqwealth.com/james-n-robinson (firm's own website states the '#1-ranked wholesaler for a $3B+ independent broker-dealer' claim and his appearances as a financial contributor on ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, and CNN). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): no independent record (network archives, wholesaler rankings from the named broker-dealer, industry press) confirms either specific claim -- both trace only to the firm's own self-description and its aggregator mirrors (RocketReach, SmartAdvisorMatch), which simply repeat the firm bio rather than independently verifying it.

people.name: Gregory Courtland Yocum
people.bio_note: Co-founder of ARQ Wealth Advisors and current Chief Compliance Officer, per SEC filing. CFP since 2004 (21+ years in the industry), added AIF in 2016. Bachelor's in business administration from Northern Arizona University (1998). Before ARQ, was a Senior Investment Manager at The Vanguard Group managing portfolios for high-net-worth clients.

people.name: Carl Steven Mariner
people.bio_note: Partner and Director of Strategic Planning at ARQ Wealth Advisors, holding CFA, CFP, and ChFC designations. Previously a Relationship Manager for ultra-high-net-worth families at Vanguard, and before that built his own investment advisory practice at a broker-dealer. Originally from Northern Michigan; relocated to the Phoenix area in 2009 with his wife, Emily.
people.bio_source: Carl Mariner's LinkedIn profile, title/credentials independently corroborated

people.name: William Darrell Lee
people.bio_note: Wealth Advisor & Portfolio Manager at ARQ Wealth Advisors (CFA, CFP), in the industry since 2003. Earned CFP in 2009 and CFA in 2014. Graduated cum laude from Arizona State University's W.P. Carey School of Business (finance) and holds a master's degree in security analysis and portfolio management from Creighton University. Named a 'Five Star Wealth Manager' annually from 2015-2025, recognized as a 'Top Financial Planner' by the Consumer Research Council of America (2014), and has been featured in the Wall Street Journal and Forbes. Past President of both the CFA Society of Phoenix and the Central Arizona Estate Planning Council.
people.bio_source: money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/william-lee-4748764 (U.S. News advisor profile) and caepc.org/members/member/109893 (Central Arizona Estate Planning Council directory), both independent of the firm's own site

firm_note.text: ARQ Wealth Advisors was founded in July 2008 — during the depths of the financial crisis — by advisors who left large institutions (including Vanguard) to build an independent, fee-only RIA focused on client service without corporate conflicts. Now manages roughly $844M for high-net-worth clients out of Scottsdale, AZ, with a team averaging 15+ years of experience and 3,000+ financial plans implemented.
firm_note.source: arqwealth.com (firm site) corroborated by CAEPC member directory and multiple advisor-network profiles (smartadvisormatch.com, theadvisoros.com) describing the 2008 founding and Vanguard lineage of its partners
